run_inference: run inference on a single benchmark system with optional warmup and timed iterations to measure QPS and GPU memory
compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute energy force and stress error metrics
format_report_table: format benchmark results dictionary as a human-readable table with energy error force MAE and performance columns
PerfCheckRunner_run: run the PerfCheckRunner benchmark to evaluate an inference configuration against an fp64 baseline on default test systems
InferenceResult: create an InferenceResult dataclass to store energy forces stress and optional performance metrics from a single inference run
